{{Top|leg}}
'''Alpha Outpost''' was a military base of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

At some point, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Capture of Alpha Outpost|captured]] Alpha Outpost, only to distract the Empire's attention from more important activities of the Alliance on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] agent of the Alliance [[Thar'quan]] was essential in the success of this operation.
